lead: Strange lunar sci-fi film still, grey moon dust, eerie toxic green glow.
notes: Mood-only mini images for unhinged_lander_heist_scifi.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen unhinged_lander_heist_scifi-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish unhinged_lander_heist_scifi-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: site
images.prompt: A concrete bunker entrance half buried in grey moon dust, a row of sealed metal doors, floodlights.

images.name: troublemaker
images.prompt: A small figure in a bulky armored spacesuit with a jetpack, standing on the moon beside a boxy old lander.

images.name: materials
images.prompt: A row of sealed glowing canisters on a shelf in a dark storage vault.

images.name: heist
images.prompt: A jetpack flame lighting up a narrow vertical shaft inside a bunker.

images.name: run
images.prompt: A boxy lunar lander touching down in a crater, dust blowing out from under it.

images.name: log
images.prompt: A wall of small framed pictures of colorful abstract explosions in a dim room.

images.name: break
images.prompt: A boxy lunar lander flying up and away from the moon's surface into the black sky.

images.name: artillery
images.prompt: A long-barreled artillery gun on a crater rim on the moon, firing a shell into the dark sky.

images.name: taxi
images.prompt: A battered boxy space taxi lander with four legs parked on grey moon rock.

images.name: seed
images.prompt: A single glowing seed in a glass jar on a dark table, colorful light swirling inside.
